verdict.rationale: Sardine documents its own background automation in its fraud and compliance domain. Users can enroll customers in ongoing monitoring and daily OFAC/PEP/adverse-media rescreening with alerts, author rules in a no-code rule engine, and rely on AI agents that auto-clear low-risk sanctions matches and route higher-risk ones to analysts. However, the agentic pieces come from marketing pages only, and there is no evidence of a user-configurable, general-purpose automation builder. missing for 10: documentation of how users configure or schedule the AI agents' autonomous workflows, general-purpose triggers and actions beyond risk rules and monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agents running unattended.
